vehicleType.source: shop country branch container via vehicles.branchId

column.source: zero-based index of the source shop range column

order.source: source shop order within a column

predecessor.source: normalized predecessors (explicit reqAir or deterministic source sequence)

folder.source: normalized groups from source shop folders

groupIndex.source: zero-based member index in the source shop folder

visualSlot.source: rank/column-local sort by normalized order and vehicle id
